title: (RHEA-2015:1179) Technology Preview: Update Satellite 5 to include Red Hat Access Insights
portal_summary:
Technology Preview of the new Red Hat Access Insights service is now available
for Red Hat Satellite 5.7.
portal_synopsis: Technology Preview: Update Satellite 5 to include Red Hat Access Insights
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Satellite is a systems management tool for Linux-based infrastructures.
It allows for provisioning, remote management and monitoring of multiple Linux
deployments with a single, centralized tool.

This enhancement update adds the powerful new Red Hat Access Insights service to
Red Hat Satellite 5.7. With Red Hat Access Insights subscribers will be able to
quickly identify key risks to stability, security, or performance in Red Hat
Enterprise Linux. (BZ#1217740)

More information about Red Hat Access Insights is available here:
https://access.redhat.com/insights/info

More information about Red Hat Technology Previews is available here:
https://access.redhat.com/support/offerings/techpreview/

All users who want to use the Red Hat Access Insights Technology Preview should
install this newly-released package, which adds this enhancement.
